$comment: Gepromed official brand tokens. Core codes are canonical; tints are for backgrounds/diagrams. Keep orange usage to ~5-10% of any composition.

blue.role: Master brand color — logo, headings, buttons, links

orange.role: Accent only (~5-10%) — the 'O' motif, safety markers, active states, key numbers, CTAs

text.role: Body copy (recommended for readability; not from logo)

rules: Blue carries the brand; orange is a rare safety/innovation marker.
Use orange for: the 'O' motif, alerts, active states, key numbers, primary CTAs.
Prefer technical diagrams over stock imagery.
Maintain generous white space for credibility and clarity.
